newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Computershare places 10 pct with Royal Bank.
newsitem.headline: Computershare places 10 pct with Royal Bank.

text.p: Software systems company Computershare Ltd said on Tuesday it had placed 10 percent of its issued capital with The Royal Bank of Scotland plc, raising just over A$17 million.
The placement of 2.29 million shares was made at A$7.50 per share.
The Royal Bank is one of Britain's leading registrars acting for over 700 companies.

"The investment by the Royal Bank will have mutual benefits, allowing them to consider migration to Computershare's software systems and providing Computershare with a foothold in the U.K. which is central to its plans for expansion," the company said.
It said the Royal Bank would make a final decision on whether to move to Computershare's systems within the next six months.
Computershare shares were 30 cents higher at A$8.80 at 10.18 a.m. (0018 GMT) on Tuesday on thin volume.
